title: 180-day revalidation treated as the currency standard for charity status
description: The overlay treats evidence up to 180 days old as current and makes 180 days a platform norm sponsors cannot downgrade. Rev. Proc. 2018-32 reliance is assessed as of each grant date and requires the grantor to keep a copy of the third-party report (§8.01). No law sets 180 days.
impact: Grants to a charity revoked inside the window could be taxable distributions under §4966; shared evidence would not satisfy per-sponsor retention.
proposed_resolution: Adopt RR-REQ-X-007-r1: an IRS-status check at approval and at release, a per-sponsor snapshot, and 180 days as a sponsor-configurable deep-review interval.

title: Carried REG-001 row says grant approval cannot be vested in software
description: §4966 taxes a manager who knowingly agrees to a taxable distribution; it does not require human approval of each grant. Whether to delegate is a governance and state-law question. Already raised as TVC-003 and OD-01, but the carried row text remains uncorrected.
impact: Could either block a lawful automation model or be read as legal certainty in either direction.
proposed_resolution: Annotate the row as overstated; resolve through counsel Q1 and RCD-005.

title: Retention floor lacks authority-keyed classes (OFAC 10 years)
description: The 7-year floor correctly yields to longer obligations, but no record class names one. OFAC records require 10 years (31 CFR 501.601, effective 2025-03-21).
impact: Sanctions records could be offered for disposition early.

title: Exclusive legal control cited to the wrong section
description: The wording comes from §170(f)(18)(B), the donor-acknowledgment rule, not §4966(d)(2). No requirement specifies acknowledgment content.
impact: Acknowledgments could omit the statement, which would cost donors their deduction (strict compliance).

title: Donor control of supporting organizations cannot be determined from IRS data
description: §4966(d)(4) makes grants to donor-controlled Type I/II/FI-III supporting organizations taxable without expenditure responsibility. TEOS/BMF cannot show control, and no requirement demands a certification.

title: OFAC blocking and reporting duties are not specified
description: Requirements cover screening and holds but not the blocking of property, the 10-business-day blocked-property report or the annual report. Screening itself is a risk-based practice, not a mandated method.
impact: Non-compliance with 31 CFR 501.603/604 after a true match.
proposed_resolution: Add UNB-RCN-REG-003; label screening authority as best practice.

title: KYC/CIP applicability correctly left open; must not be imported as law
description: No BSA/CIP mandate applies to a charity paying its own grants. The answer may change if a for-profit administrator holds or moves funds.
impact: Over-engineering onboarding or mislabeling controls as legal duties.
proposed_resolution: Keep identity verification as a fraud and authorization control; counsel Q8.

title: Superseded Rev. Proc. 2011-33 cited in evidence
description: Rev. Proc. 2018-32 supersedes it, with the same substance.
proposed_resolution: Cite Rev. Proc. 2018-32 in all new records.

title: No regulatory-change watch for pending DAF guidance
description: REG-142338-07 is still proposed, and the 2026–27 PGP lists §§4966/6033 DAF guidance. No requirement assigns monitoring or impact review.
impact: Requirements silently drift from law when guidance issues.

title: No excess-business-holdings computation
description: §4943(e) applies to DAFs, including holdings of donors and related persons. Complex-asset requirements do not compute it.
impact: Accepting closely held business interests could trigger §4943 taxes.

title: Strata assigned capabilities it does not have
description: Strata v0.1.1 (pilot) is a declarative PostgreSQL schema-management CLI. It provides no append-only history, posting, temporal query, replay, projection or data integrity check.
impact: The persistence architecture is unimplementable as written; financial integrity would rest on a non-existent capability.
proposed_resolution: Adopt RR-UNB-PLAT-007-r1: an Unbound-owned Ledger/Event Store on managed PostgreSQL, with Strata as the schema-governance and drift layer.

title: Dynamic terminology has no owner
description: Forma excludes terminology by design (BRAND-012), and no Unbound requirement assigns it.
impact: Inconsistent sponsor vocabulary across channels; legally required phrases could be overridden.

title: No contract source of truth or format
description: Versioned contracts are required, but no requirement names the format, the generation source or a breaking-change gate.
impact: Drift between code, documentation and AI-discoverable contracts.

title: Protective emergency plane and outage intake add a second durable system
description: REQ-X-020/021 introduce an independently durable protective-only plane and nonauthoritative intake outside the monolith, without cost, ownership or failure-mode evidence that managed-database high availability is insufficient.
impact: Operational complexity contrary to the managed, modular-monolith direction.
proposed_resolution: Require an ADR showing the failure mode that managed HA plus a read-only degraded mode cannot handle before building a separate plane (RCD-012).
